test_title: PYST 35: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below. While the first and the last sentences (S1 and S6) are in the correct order, the sentences in between are jumbled up. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

S1. A moment comes

A. long suppressed

B. and when the soul of a nation

C. which comes but rarely in history

D. when we step out from the old to the new, when an age ends

S6. finds utterance.
solution:
The correct order is: **CDBA.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Sentence C, **"which comes but rarely in history," naturally follows the opening line S1, "A moment comes," because it describes the type of moment being referred to.
 
• **Sentence D**, "when we step out from the old to the new, when an age ends," expands on the rarity and significance of such a moment.
 
• **Sentence B** further describes the moment as being significant to the soul of a nation, which follows nicely from the idea of a historical transition.
 
• **Sentence A** then qualifies the nation’s soul as being “long suppressed” which complements the previous sentence and leads logically into the final sentence S6.

Therefore the correct answer is **"Option 2". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The order of sentences in a paragraph should create a logical sequence that builds up to the main point or conclusion, as reflected in the first and last sentences.
